verses.original: שִׁגָּי֗וֹן לְדָ֫וִ֥ד אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁ֥ר לַיהוָ֑ה עַל־ דִּבְרֵי־ כ֝֗וּשׁ בֶּן־ יְמִינִֽי׃ יְהוָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהַי בְּךָ֣ חָסִ֑יתִי הוֹשִׁיעֵ֥נִי מִכָּל־ רֹ֝דְפַ֗י וְהַצִּילֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: šig·gā·yō·wn lə·ḏā·wiḏ ’ă·šer- šār Yah·weh ‘al- diḇ·rê- ḵūš ben- yə·mî·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hay bə·ḵā ḥā·sî·ṯî hō·wō·šî·‘ê·nî mik·kāl rō·ḏə·p̄ay wə·haṣ·ṣî·lê·nî
verses.literal: A Shiggaion of David which he sang to the LORD concerning the words of Cush a Benjamite O LORD my God I take refuge in You save me and deliver me from all my pursuers
verses.literalPt: SENHOR meu Deus, em ti confio; salva-me de todos os que me perseguem, e livra-me;

verses.original: פֶּן־ יִטְרֹ֣ף כְּאַרְיֵ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֑י פֹּ֝רֵ֗ק וְאֵ֣ין מַצִּֽיל׃
verses.transliteration: pen- yiṭ·rōp̄ kə·’ar·yêh nap̄·šî pō·rêq wə·’ên maṣ·ṣîl
verses.literal: or they will shred my soul like a lion and tear me to pieces with no one to rescue me
verses.literalPt: Para que ele não arrebate a minha alma, como leão, despedaçando-a, sem que haja quem a livre.

verses.original: יְהוָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהַי אִם־ עָשִׂ֣יתִי זֹ֑את אִֽם־ יֶשׁ־ עָ֥וֶל בְּכַפָּֽי׃
verses.literal: O LORD my God if I have done this if injustice is on my hands
verses.literalPt: SENHOR meu Deus, se eu fiz isto, se há perversidade nas minhas mãos,

verses.original: אִם־ גָּ֭מַלְתִּי שֽׁוֹלְמִ֥י רָ֑ע וָאֲחַלְּצָ֖ה צוֹרְרִ֣י רֵיקָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- gā·mal·tî šō·wl·mî rā‘ wā·’ă·ḥal·lə·ṣāh ṣō·wr·rî rê·qām
verses.literal: if I have rewarded my ally with evil if I have plundered my foe without cause
verses.literalPt: Se paguei com o mal àquele que tinha paz comigo (antes, livrei ao que me oprimia sem causa),

verses.original: יִֽרַדֹּ֥ף אוֹיֵ֨ב׀ נַפְשִׁ֡י וְיַשֵּׂ֗ג וְיִרְמֹ֣ס לָאָ֣רֶץ חַיָּ֑י וּכְבוֹדִ֓י׀ לֶעָפָ֖ר יַשְׁכֵּ֣ן סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: yi·rad·dōp̄ ’ō·w·yêḇ nap̄·šî wə·yaś·śêḡ wə·yir·mōs lā·’ā·reṣ ḥay·yāy ū·ḵə·ḇō·w·ḏî le·‘ā·p̄ār yaš·kên se·lāh
verses.literal: then may my enemy pursue me and overtake me may he trample me to the ground and leave my honor in the dust Selah
verses.literalPt: Persiga o inimigo a minha alma e alcance-a; calque aos pés a minha vida sobre a terra, e reduza a pó a minha glória. (Selá.)

verses.original: ק֘וּמָ֤ה יְהוָ֨ה׀ בְּאַפֶּ֗ךָ הִ֭נָּשֵׂא בְּעַבְר֣וֹת צוֹרְרָ֑י וְע֥וּרָה אֵ֝לַ֗י מִשְׁפָּ֥ט צִוִּֽיתָ׃
verses.transliteration: qū·māh Yah·weh bə·’ap·pe·ḵā hin·nā·śê bə·‘aḇ·rō·wṯ ṣō·wr·rāy wə·‘ū·rāh ’ê·lay miš·pāṭ ṣiw·wî·ṯā
verses.literal: Arise O LORD in Your anger rise up against the fury of my enemies Awake my God and ordain judgment
verses.literalPt: Levanta-te, SENHOR, na tua ira; exalta-te por causa do furor dos meus opressores; e desperta por mim para o juízo que ordenaste.

verses.original: וַעֲדַ֣ת לְ֭אֻמִּים תְּסוֹבְבֶ֑ךָּ וְ֝עָלֶ֗יהָ לַמָּר֥וֹם שֽׁוּבָה׃
verses.transliteration: wa·‘ă·ḏaṯ lə·’um·mîm tə·sō·wḇ·ḇe·kā wə·‘ā·le·hā lam·mā·rō·wm šū·ḇāh
verses.literal: Let the assembled peoples gather around You take Your seat over them on high
verses.literalPt: Assim te rodeará o ajuntamento de povos; por causa deles, pois, volta-te para as alturas.

verses.original: יְהוָה֮ יָדִ֪ין עַ֫מִּ֥ים שָׁפְטֵ֥נִי יְהוָ֑ה כְּצִדְקִ֖י וּכְתֻמִּ֣י עָלָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh yā·ḏîn ‘am·mîm šā·p̄ə·ṭê·nî Yah·weh kə·ṣiḏ·qî ū·ḵə·ṯum·mî ‘ā·lāy
verses.literal: The LORD judges the peoples vindicate me O LORD according to my righteousness and integrity . . .
verses.literalPt: O SENHOR julgará os povos; julga-me, SENHOR, conforme a minha justiça, e conforme a integridade que há em mim.

verses.original: יִגְמָר־ נָ֬א רַ֨ע׀ רְשָׁעִים֮ וּתְכוֹנֵ֪ן צַ֫דִּ֥יק וּבֹחֵ֣ן לִ֭בּ֗וֹת וּכְלָי֗וֹת אֱלֹהִ֥ים צַדִּֽיק׃
verses.transliteration: yiḡ·mār- nā ra‘ rə·šā·‘îm ū·ṯə·ḵō·w·nên ṣad·dîq ū·ḇō·ḥên lib·bō·wṯ ū·ḵə·lā·yō·wṯ ’ĕ·lō·hîm ṣad·dîq
verses.literal: Put an end to the evil of the wicked but establish the righteous O righteous God who searches hearts and minds
verses.literalPt: Tenha já fim a malícia dos ímpios; mas estabeleça-se o justo; pois tu, ó justo Deus, provas os corações e os rins.

verses.original: מָֽגִנִּ֥י עַל־ אֱלֹהִ֑ים מ֝וֹשִׁ֗יעַ יִשְׁרֵי־ לֵֽב׃
verses.literal: My shield is with God who saves the upright in heart
verses.literalPt: O meu escudo é de Deus, que salva os retos de coração.

verses.original: אֱ֭לֹהִים שׁוֹפֵ֣ט צַדִּ֑יק וְ֝אֵ֗ל זֹעֵ֥ם בְּכָל־ יֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·lō·hîm šō·w·p̄êṭ ṣad·dîq wə·’êl zō·‘êm bə·ḵāl yō·wm
verses.literal: God is a righteous judge and a God who feels indignation each day
verses.literalPt: Deus é juiz justo, um Deus que se ira todos os dias.

verses.original: אִם־ לֹ֣א יָ֭שׁוּב חַרְבּ֣וֹ יִלְט֑וֹשׁ קַשְׁתּ֥וֹ דָ֝רַ֗ךְ וַֽיְכוֹנְנֶֽהָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- lō yā·šūḇ ḥar·bōw yil·ṭō·wōš qaš·tōw ḏā·raḵ way·ḵō·wn·ne·hā
verses.literal: If one does not repent God will sharpen His sword He has bent and strung His bow
verses.literalPt: Se o homem não se converter, Deus afiará a sua espada; já tem armado o seu arco, e está aparelhado.

verses.original: וְ֭לוֹ הֵכִ֣ין כְּלֵי־ מָ֑וֶת חִ֝צָּ֗יו לְֽדֹלְקִ֥ים יִפְעָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lōw hê·ḵîn kə·lê- mā·weṯ ḥiṣ·ṣāw lə·ḏō·lə·qîm yip̄·‘āl
verses.literal: He has prepared His deadly weapons He ordains His arrows with fire
verses.literalPt: E já para ele preparou armas mortais; e porá em ação as suas setas inflamadas contra os perseguidores.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֥ה יְחַבֶּל־ אָ֑וֶן וְהָרָ֥ה עָ֝מָ֗ל וְיָ֣לַד שָֽׁקֶר׃
verses.literal: Behold the wicked man travails with evil he conceives trouble and births falsehood
verses.literalPt: Eis que ele está com dores de perversidade; concebeu trabalhos, e produziu mentiras.

verses.original: בּ֣וֹר כָּ֭רָֽה וַֽיַּחְפְּרֵ֑הוּ וַ֝יִּפֹּ֗ל בְּשַׁ֣חַת יִפְעָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: bō·wr kā·rāh way·yaḥ·pə·rê·hū way·yip·pōl bə·ša·ḥaṯ yip̄·‘āl
verses.literal: He has dug a hole and hollowed it out he has fallen into a pit of his own making
verses.literalPt: Cavou um poço e o fez fundo, e caiu na cova que fez.

verses.original: יָשׁ֣וּב עֲמָל֣וֹ בְרֹאשׁ֑וֹ וְעַ֥ל קָ֝דְקֳד֗וֹ חֲמָס֥וֹ יֵרֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: yā·šūḇ ‘ă·mā·lōw ḇə·rō·šōw wə·‘al qā·ḏə·qo·ḏōw ḥă·mā·sōw yê·rêḏ
verses.literal: His trouble recoils on himself and his violence falls on his own head
verses.literalPt: A sua obra cairá sobre a sua cabeça; e a sua violência descerá sobre a sua própria cabeça.

verses.original: אוֹדֶ֣ה יְהוָ֣ה כְּצִדְק֑וֹ וַ֝אֲזַמְּרָ֗ה שֵֽׁם־ יְהוָ֥ה עֶלְיֽוֹן׃
verses.literal: I will thank the LORD for His righteousness and sing praise to the name of the LORD Most High
verses.literalPt: Eu louvarei ao SENHOR segundo a sua justiça, e cantarei louvores ao nome do SENHOR altíssimo.
